Site: 9 Sedge Lane, Eastmere
Dwelling: detached, 3 bedrooms
Proposal: single-storey side extension, utility room
The extension comes within 3.2 m of the lime tree on the boundary.

Lime tree at 9 Sedge Lane boundary: Tree Preservation Order 31/2017, confirmed.
No tree survey is held for this site.
